meaning:
freshness, fresh green, green shoots, or greenery
Aramaic equivalent: ev (אֵב "fruit" H0004)

renderings.kjv: Whilst it is yet in his greenness

elsewhere.note: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
I went down into the nut tree grove, to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine budded, and the pomegranates were in flower.
